extracted.intended_audience: patent applicants and practitioners seeking to use the USPTO After Final Consideration Pilot Program 2.0 (AFCP 2.0)
extracted.subtask_description: Procedural requirements, deadlines, and submission content rules for filing a request to have an after-final response considered under the USPTO After Final Consideration Pilot Program 2.0.

rubrics_metrics.name: Program expiration and extension
rubrics_metrics.description: The USPTO has decided to allow the After Final Consideration Pilot Program 2.0 (AFCP 2.0) to expire; a short extension of the expiration of the program was provided to December 14, 2024.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Saturday, December 14, was the last day to submit a request for participation under the program. Requests for participation filed on Sunday, December 15, and thereafter will not be accepted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Deadline for filing AFCP 2.0 request
rubrics_metrics.description: Any request to consider a response after final rejection under AFCP 2.0 had to be filed on or before December 14, 2024.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: AFCP 2.0 requests that are submitted after December 14, 2024 are non-responsive.

rubrics_metrics.name: Required submission content (37 C.F.R. 1.116 submission)
rubrics_metrics.description: A 37 C.F.R. 1.116 submission, including the after final response, must be filed with the request for participation under AFCP 2.0.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The 37 C.F.R 1.116 submission, including the after final response, filed with requests submitted after December 14 will not be considered or entered.

rubrics_metrics.name: Non-acceptance / non-responsiveness of late requests
rubrics_metrics.description: Requests for participation filed after December 14 will not be accepted or entered and are considered non-responsive.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Requests filed on Sunday, December 15, and thereafter will not be accepted, and the 37 C.F.R 1.116 submission, including the after final response, filed with such requests will not be considered or entered.

rubrics_metrics.name: 35 U.S.C. 21(b) inapplicability to late filings
rubrics_metrics.description: The provisions of 35 U.S.C. 21(b) do not apply to requests filed on December 15 or December 16 because December 14, 2024 is the end of a discretionary pilot program, not the expiration of a period within which an action must be taken or a fee paid.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Therefore, requests filed after December 14 are not the 'taking [of] any action' as articulated in the 35 U.S.C. 21(b).

rubrics_metrics.name: Effect on the applicant's time period to reply
rubrics_metrics.description: The time period for reply set in the final rejection will continue to run irrespective of AFCP 2.0 requests filed after the deadline.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: AFCP 2.0 requests submitted after December 14 are non-responsive, and the normal reply period set in the final rejection remains in effect.

rubrics_metrics.name: Further information and alternative options after program end
rubrics_metrics.description: More information, including various options still available to applicants for after final consideration once the program ends, is available in the Federal Register notice.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Refer to the linked Federal Register notice for the full explanation of options available after AFCP 2.0 ends.

rubrics_metrics.name: FAQ and contact resources
rubrics_metrics.description: Frequently Asked Questions document and contact points are provided for questions regarding AFCP 2.0.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A FAQ PDF (last updated September 30, 2024) is available. Questions may be emailed to the AFCP 2.0 mailbox. Phone contacts: Electronic Business Center (Patent Center questions) at 866-217-9197; Tariq Hafiz, Director, Technology Center 3600 (application-specific issues) at 571-272-5350; Raul Tamayo, Senior Legal Advisor, Office of Patent Legal Administration (questions regarding the Federal Register notice) at 571-272-7728.
